# Welcome to the Library Handbook

This handbook explains how Elm Street Community Library runs its digital services: the public computers, the Wi-Fi, e-book lending and the online catalogue. It is written for staff and volunteers. You don't need any technical knowledge to use it.

> [!TIP]
> New here? Read [Getting Started](Getting-Started.md) first. It takes about five minutes.

## What's inside

| Section | What you'll find | Start with |
|---|---|---|
| Guides | Everyday tasks and answers for patrons | [[Introduction]] |
| Technical | How our systems fit together | [[Architecture]] |
| References | Plain-language definitions | [[Glossary]] |

## How the handbook is organised

Each page covers one topic. Pages link to each other, so you can follow a question from the front desk all the way to the system that answers it.

For example, if a patron can't borrow an e-book, start with [Troubleshooting](Guides/Troubleshooting.md#e-book-loans). If you want to understand why it happened, look at the [loan diagram](Technical/Diagrams.md#how-an-e-book-loan-works).
